title: Underwriting Inspections and Condition Letters on the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy
content:
Every new HomeGuard Homeowners Policy receives one new-business inspection of the package's new-business inspection type (exterior, or exterior and interior), ordered no later than the package's inspection order period in days after the bound date. A roof reinspection is ordered only when the named insured reports a roof replacement. Inspections are ordered only while the policy is bound or in force, as the policy record shows.

## Condition letters and cure

- Each inspection finding other than "none" receives exactly one condition letter.
- The cure due date on the letter is the inspection completion date plus the package's cure period in calendar days.
- A condition is cured only when the proof of correction is received no later than the cure due date that follows the inspection completion date. The cure period is counted in calendar days from the inspection completion date recorded for that inspection, and proof received on the cure due date itself is on time.
- A condition that has already been cured is never cured again.

*Hypothetical boundary pair:* inspection completed 10 April with a hypothetical cure period of 30 days gives a cure due date of 10 May. Proof received on 10 May cures the condition; proof received on 11 May does not.

## Accepted proof by finding

| Finding | Kind | Proof of correction |
|---|---|---|
| Unfenced trampoline | hazard | photographs or a contractor invoice |
| Unfenced pool | hazard | photographs or a contractor invoice |
| Uncertified wood stove | hazard | photographs or a contractor invoice |
| Missing stair handrail | hazard | photographs or a contractor invoice |
| Debris hazard | hazard | photographs or a contractor invoice |
| Roof defect | hazard | photographs or a contractor invoice |
| Roof at end of life | eligibility | a completed roof reinspection or a licensed electrician's certificate |
| Knob-and-tube wiring | eligibility | a completed roof reinspection or a licensed electrician's certificate |
| Fuse panel | eligibility | a completed roof reinspection or a licensed electrician's certificate |

When a roof-at-end-of-life finding is cured by a new roof, the roof material and roof install year on the policy are updated to the new roof, and the roof settlement basis becomes replacement cost for the rest of the term.

## An uncured finding

A finding left uncured after its cure due date is an underwriting ground. Inside the new business period it supports cancellation under the HomeGuard underwriting cancellation conditions; afterwards it supports nonrenewal under the HomeGuard nonrenewal rules.

An inspection finding, cured or not, never changes how a claim is paid.
